Both assistants reach the correct answer. Using inclusion-exclusion, P(blue or green) = 58% + 45% − 22% = 81%, so P(neither) = 100% − 81% = 19%.

Assistant A defines the events explicitly (A, B, and A ∩ B) and shows each step, which makes the reasoning easy to follow. Assistant B gives the same calculation more concisely, stating the complement rule and the subtraction of the overlap, and it also gives the decimal form (0.19). Neither has an error, and the difference in clarity is minor, so neither is clearly better.
